services.name: Structured JSON Quality Audit
services.description: Deterministic QA for up to 500 JSON records. Returns schema columns, missing-value counts, per-column observed types, duplicate-row count, and a reproducible SHA-256 fingerprint. No credentials or private data sources required.

records.description: Array of JSON values/objects to audit.

quality_report.description: Deterministic quality report including counts, types, duplicates and SHA-256 fingerprint.

services.name: Prompt Injection & Tool-Abuse Risk Scan
services.description: Deterministic scan of untrusted text for prompt-injection, secret-exfiltration, role-override, encoded-payload, and tool-abuse indicators. Returns a risk score, concrete matched findings, fingerprint, and safe-handling guidance.

risk_report.description: Risk score, findings, SHA-256 fingerprint, and safe-handling guidance.

services.name: Public URL Health & Metadata Audit
services.description: Safe automated audit for a public HTTP/HTTPS URL. Returns final URL, status, response time, HTTPS posture, selected response headers, title, and meta description. Private/local network targets are blocked.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to audit.

audit.description: HTTP/HTTPS health, timing, selected headers, and page metadata.
